citation.authors: Nicolaidou E, Mastraftsi S, Tzanetakou V, Rigopoulos D

cited_by.title: Vitiligo, spread, starting age and treatment options

record.finding: Childhood vitiligo can appear from the first years of life. According to the guidelines the authors cite, topical corticosteroids, topical calcineurin inhibitors and narrowband UVB are the most used treatments in children.
